Name: ChessGame
description: My first try programming anything using "real" source code instead of some kind of software or automation suite. It was a lot of work, but it gave me the possibility to try out my limits and find out about the typical beginners problems, from arrays to loops, and to expand my programming skills. After that I used it to learn about graphics and rendering.

Name: Askozia VoIP server setup
description:
I helped research and test different Software and then setup a new askozia PBP server.
 The work included planning and implementation of a voice mail service.

Name: Cryprography with SHA 512
description: My first software for productive use (internal), it was used to set default values and configure mediafusion zero. The configuration console was protected by a password encrypted using SHA512 and offered the possibility to save new passwords.

Name: Copy/Update Tool
description:
mediafusion manages data in form of a tree (e.g. Series , Seasons and Episodes).
To improve Data Recording speed, I implemented the Copy/Update tool, enabling users to update information to the underlying nodes or leaves or to copy whole datasets.

Name: Role based Access Control
description: An admin console to create and invalidate user groups and roles. Setting of View patterns per Role to control read, write and admin access to single fields in the application.

Name: mfXE13 Base modules
description:
I implemented the new version of mediafusion using Delphi XE!
An information-management solution for licencing specialists. I was part of a team of two and developed the framework as well as different features.
For further info please visit: Homepage of 3Points GmbH

Name: mfXE13 Revenue module
description:
A new module to manage and calculate revenues was needed in mediafusion.
I implemented the new module from scratch, from the database design to the GUI. The whole revenue process for the Red Arrow Systems International licencing was covered and it was subequently updated with complex controlling views to help the managers keep track of the cashflow.
I also offered updates and bugfixes for several years.

Name: Webavail "Sell It All"
description:
I implemented the filter functionalities for the project SELL IT ALL a new web dashboard for mediafusion, this gave me the opportunity to learn how to work with Java and the Glassfish server.
The feature needed conception and realization of functionalities in the frontend as well as the backend.

Used technologies:
- Java EE 7
- Payara 4.x
- Vaadin 8

Name: Bamboo release automation
description:
After working on the new Prototype, we had a lot of technical diifficulties deploying the new Webpages correctly, since developers had to manually pull feartures and configs together to compile Release versions.
That lead way to often to small small errors, leading to multiple hotfix deliveries and bloated costs for both parties.
After a short period of time, I planned and implemented an automatic delivery System in Bamboo and JIRA, tha was able to create new feature branches, and pulling the right ones back together at release time, as well as compiling the code end getting an installable package ready for deployment. (local or remote)
The new automation reduced management costs significantly since a tidy organisation in JIRA was everithing that was needed to keep everithing running without hickups.

Used Technologies:
- Atlassian Tool Stack
- Bamboo Config as Code (Groovy based DSL)
- Linux Shell / Power Shell

Name: mfXE13 Invoice module
description:
I implemented an automatic invoicing system. It checked revenues and offered an interface to the SAP system as well as various security features and an archivation system.

Used Technologies:
- Delphi XE 7
- FastReport 5

Name: HEIDI Replatforming
description:
Rebuild of a pre-2000 leasing and financing platform on a current stack. I planned and wrote test cases, implemented the fixes coming out of every test phase and ran test and defect management in HP ALM.

Used Technologies:
- HP ALM
- Python
- Java EE
- JSP
- JSF 2.0
lang: Java EE / JSF 2.0 / Oracle DB / Payara

Name: Licence sales web portal
description:
Web portal for the fast lookup of available licences at trade fairs, including personalised flyer generation for visitors. I owned conception, realisation, deployment and the ongoing maintenance of the portal, next to my working-student role.

Used Technologies:
- Java EE / Hibernate / Payara
- Vue.js
- Jira / Bitbucket / Bamboo
- Windows Server administration

Name: Personal Dyn Dns
description:
A dynamic DNS service I designed, built and host myself. It has been running since October 2019.

Used Technologies:
- Java / Spring Boot
- nginx
- Ubuntu Server
lang: Java / Spring Boot / nginx / Ubuntu Server

Name: Speech Controlled Music Player
description:
Contributions to the open-source voice assistant Mycroft AI: voice dialogue intents and apps published to the Mycroft marketplace, among them a Plex music skill. I maintained the skills, helped users with the installation and moderated feature requests.

Used Technologies:
- Python
- Mycroft Core / Mimic3 / Mycroft Precise
- Mozilla Common Voice

Name: Remote Service Systems
description:
Remote-access solution for bottling and filling lines at Krones AG, via Cisco devices. I integrated the customer logins with Azure AD using SAML and AWS Cognito, implemented features and resolved defects, with direct customer contact throughout.

Used Technologies:
- Java / Spring / Hibernate
- JUnit / Cucumber
- Azure AD with SAML / AWS Cognito
- GitLab CI
lang: Java / Spring / Hibernate / Azure AD / AWS Cognito

Name: Energy Management Systems
description:
Control, monitoring and report generation across the power installations of retail stores and warehouses, for Schwarz IT KG. Maintenance and feature development in a team of two, with direct customer contact; I also helped introduce Scrum and refine the product backlog.

Used Technologies:
- Java / Spring / Hibernate
- JUnit / Cucumber
- GitLab CI / Jira

Name: Mobih - mobile maintenance for car production
description:
Paper-based maintenance processes in Porsche AG's automobile production, replaced by an iOS application designed around the existing analogue workflow. I gathered the requirements with the business department, built features and tests, ran the cloud deployment through infrastructure as code, integrated the on-premise SAP systems as the backend and mentored junior developers on the client side.

Used Technologies:
- TypeScript / Angular / RxJS
- Jest / Cypress
- AWS / CDK
- Bamboo / GitLab CI / SonarQube

Name: HEIDI - leasing and financing sales portal
description:
Online portal for the sale of leasing and financing products at BMW Financial Services - the same platform whose replatforming I had worked on in 2018/19, rejoined four years later as a developer in a team of eleven. Feature development and customer change requests, production log analysis, code quality work and maintenance of the Jenkins pipelines and DevOps processes.

Used Technologies:
- Java EE / JSF 2.0 / Hibernate / Payara
- JUnit
- Jenkins / SonarQube
lang: Java EE / JSF 2.0 / Hibernate / Payara / Jenkins

Name: AWS microservices for financing products
description:
Operation and deployment of more than 60 AWS backend microservices integrating and calculating financial products inside the Volkswagen Financial Services cloud ecosystem. I migrated legacy services, designed and built new ones, advised the business department and produced the effort estimates.

Used Technologies:
- TypeScript / Java / NestJS / Express
- Concourse CI on AWS Fargate / containers
- Supertest / Jest / K6 load testing
- BFF framework
lang: TypeScript / Java / NestJS / AWS / Concourse CI

Name: IFRS 9 regulatory platform
description:
Maintenance and modernisation of a long-lived regulatory codebase at Porsche Bank, in a team of three: refactoring, security updates, replacement of outdated dependencies and cross-OS compatibility work. I own the pipelines and DevOps processes, including their migration into the AWS cloud, next to feature development and customer change requests.

Used Technologies:
- Java EE / Hibernate / WildFly
- JUnit
- GitLab CI / SonarQube / AWS
lang: Java EE / Hibernate / WildFly / GitLab CI / AWS

Name: GitLab runner migration to AWS
description:
Migration of the company GitLab build agents into AWS as the sole engineer, against a fixed cut-over date and with several teams depending on the runners throughout. I aligned the setup with the corporate security and compliance standards and delivered a reusable Terraform template for future runners.

Used Technologies:
- Terraform
- EKS / VPC / VPN / Route 53
- AWS Cloud Services

Name: Digital euro showcase application
description:
A synchronised digital payment application and a companion mobile app for Pioneer Investments, including a tested client for the ECB REST APIs. I ran the requirements gathering with the business department, owned the process design and documentation for both the client and the developers, and carried team responsibility for two junior developers in a team of six.

Used Technologies:
- TypeScript / React / Material UI
- Express / Prisma / PostgreSQL
- Docker / REST
- Jest / Cypress

Name: BSI CRM customer platforms
description:
Two customer platforms built on BSI's proprietary CRM base software, both administering operations at European scale, for BSI with Techem as the end customer. I keep them running and current in two-person teams: maintenance, dependency and platform updates and feature work across the Spring and Oracle backends and the Angular front end.

Used Technologies:
- Java / Spring
- Oracle
- Angular
- BSI CRM
lang: Java / Spring / Oracle / Angular / BSI CRM

Name: Physician fee settlement — objections and damages
description:
Long-established Excel-based processes replaced by a web application, for a Kassenärztliche Vereinigung — the public-law body that settles panel doctors' fees. The system handles objections (Widerspruch) against fee notices and claims for sonstige Schäden arising out of that settlement. Spring Boot backend, Vue 3 front end with Pinia, the whole system running on Kubernetes.

A team of four: an architect, myself as senior developer and two junior developers. AI-assisted engineering is a standing part of delivery here — GitHub Copilot and Claude in the daily development loop, self-built agentic workflows for recurring engineering work, and hands-on enablement of the two juniors on both.

Used Technologies:
- Java / Spring Boot
- Vue 3 / Pinia / TypeScript
- Kubernetes
- GitHub Copilot / Claude / agentic workflows
lang: Java / Spring Boot / Vue 3 / Pinia / Kubernetes / AI-assisted development
